item.description: Date: Thursday, October 8, 2026 9:00 AM - 4:00 PM - Every Thursday is MANE Trivia in JEC 2012 from 9 am - 4 pm. Stop by to test your knowledge of Engineering, RPI and miscellaneous trivia. Prizes!!

item.title: Big Red BBQ at Reunion and Homecoming (Registration Required)
item.description: Date: Saturday, October 10, 2026 2:00 PM - 4:00 PM - Calling all students! The Office of Alumni Engagement invites you to join RPI alumni at this year’s signature Reunion and Homecoming event. Enjoy great food, a live band, and fun games while connecting with alumni from across the generations. If you have a campus meal plan, you’ll use your meal swipe on site. Don’t have a meal plan? No problem — you’re still invited to enjoy the BBQ! Pre-registration is REQUIRED.

item.title: Fellowship Info Session to Highlight Competitions for Grad School Tuition and Salary Oct. 14, 2pm
item.description: Competitive fellowships provide salary and tuition for masters and PhD students. Juniors, seniors, and graduate students will learn how to find and apply to appropriate programs that will fund fall of 2027 and beyond. Funding opportunities are available for all stages of your academic career. International students are welcome! Register for the virtual session at https://surveys.rpi.edu/jfe/form/SV_6L3FFwv0qCROrvE Questions? madige@rpi.edu

item.title: Audio from Lost in Liquid Noise
item.description: Saturday / October 10, 2026 at 11:00 am Every day, Greenland loses 600 million tons of ice. Most people cannot perceive this. Sound artist Felix Deufel and video artist Lucas Gutierrez made it tangible—as sound, space, and embodied experience.Lost in Liquid Noise is an immersive audio-driven experience based on two Arctic expeditions (2023 & 2024). It reveals the hidden sonic and visual dimensions of climate change—from glacier ruptures to underwater ecosystems beneath frozen seas…
item.author: Community

item.title: CEE Distinguished Alumni Celebration
item.description: Date: Saturday, October 10, 2026 4:00 PM - 6:00 PM - Join us as we present this year’s Civil & Environmental Engineering Distinguished Alumni award to Thomas G. Capek. Mr. Capek graduated from RPI with a B.S. in civil engineering in 1986. He has had an industrious career at Corning Inc., using his civil degree as a base for further learning and preparation for many industrial challenges. Dessert reception will be in the DCC Great Hall with formal presentation in DCC 330.
item.author: Community

item.title: Alumni Weekend Side-by-Side Rehearsal with the RPI Symphony Orchestra
item.description: Experience the excitement of the RPI Symphony Orchestra as current students and alumni reunite for a special open rehearsal under the direction of Dr. Robert Whalen. This unique side-by-side event honors the alumni whose continued commitment and musicianship have helped shape the Orchestra’s tradition of excellence while offering a behind-the-scenes look at preparations for its 154th season. Join us on 10/10 at 1pm in DCC 308.
item.author: Community

item.title: DSES PhD Candidate John Nichols Receives U.S. Coast Guard Patches in Recognition of Research
item.description: John Nichols, Decision Sciences and Engineering Systems PhD candidate ’28, received the US Coast Guard Sector Western Alaska & US Arctic patches, presented by Prof Martha Grabowski, for assisting the US Coast Guard with modeling prioritized inspection schedules for Arctic bulk fuel facilities. Congratulations, John, and thank you to Shawn Hay (USCG Arctic Coordinator) and LT Brett Woodward, (USCG Sector Western Alaska and U.S. Arctic) who provided the patches!

item.title: Parking Notice - Reunion and Homecoming Weekend 2026
item.description:
As we get ready for a fun-filled weekend of activities across campus on October 8-11, 2026, please expect extra traffic, busier parking areas, and changes to traffic patterns. Please help us welcome our alumni and guest back home to RPI and we thank you for your patience and cooperation as we celebrate Reunion & Homecoming together!
